query:
UPDATE trustees SET seniorityOrder = CASE
  WHEN role LIKE '%Chair%' THEN 1
  WHEN role LIKE '%Trustee%' AND role NOT LIKE '%Chair%' THEN 2
  WHEN role LIKE '%Senior Manager%' THEN 3
  WHEN role LIKE '%Manager%' AND role NOT LIKE '%Deputy%' AND role NOT LIKE '%Senior%' THEN 4
  WHEN role LIKE '%Deputy%' THEN 5
  WHEN role LIKE '%Staff%' THEN 6
  ELSE 99
END;
